Allow users to configure a custom status workflow per project.
1. Workbook should ship with the default statuses, but add a new CLI command and web interface to add/update/reorder/delete status options.
2. Config should be saved in a ref just like a task so that it can be synced with the repo, and future updates tracked the same way. This will also allow future other custom configuration options. It gets synced/pushed along with tasks.
3. Web interface needs to account for reading and displaying the currently configured status columns and correctly render tasks inside them.
4. Need to account for cascading changes to existing tasks when a status is updated/deleted, and fallback for changes that don't get corrected immediately because of distributed data

---

## Work state (captured 2026-08-11, orchestration pause)

Implemented as five sequential PRs (A-E). Full designs live in the two design reports summarized in the PR bodies below; each PR carries an adversarial review record in its comments.

**Merged:**
- PR-A #82 (core): core/vocabulary.go (Vocabulary API, ordering + default/next/done tags, arity Validate with fix-naming messages, LegacyVocabulary()==DefaultVocabulary() pinned equal until story 3), configop.go (config.genesis + 8 status.* ops, resolved-state checkpoints, ApplyConfig deterministic/never-fails with fixed-order arity normalization, default exclusive-by-construction), the validation move (replay structural via validateStatusToken kebab<=40; vocabulary membership at the Service boundary; golden byte-compat test proving existing task refs unchanged), correct-on-touch (Update/Place, statusCorrected member), ConfigConflict second union. Ceilings are AUTHORING-ONLY (fold never fails; over-ceiling folds are advisories).
- PR-B #83 (gitstore/sync): refs/workbook/config canonical + tracking + parked/config/<n>; LoadVocabulary memoized, LegacyVocabulary fallback offline; WriteConfigOperation with lazy genesis-from-legacy (creation IS the CAS); singleton reconcile with classify -> ConfigConflict, root-divergence = adopt origin root + replay; resource bounds MaxConfigOperationsPerPack=64 / MaxConfigLedgerReplayCommits=128 as peer-refusals (operational, never corrupt-data); sync stage identity->config->tasks in the one fetch (glob refspecs); Moved flag drives syncloop changedRefs; publish invariant (ledger rides Push/Sync/PushTask with the carve-out warning shape); settlement extended to Move/Depend/Free (Restore settles on next write); historyvalidation config fold + over-ceiling advisory.
- PR-C #84 (CLI): workbook status list|add|rename|label|move|tag|untag|delete --into|log; envelopes command=full verb, {change, vocabulary, tasks{affected, claimableAfter via DependenciesDone}, inverse{command,exact,note}}; ONE statusPackInverse computation for verb + log (log entries are per-commit — accepted deviation); shell-executed round-trip tests; list --status relaxation with envelope warnings (chain-honest wording); seeded:false; over-ceiling advisory in status list; bounded walks (log reads only the --limit window via ReadConfigHistoryTail; list dates retirements from maxDatedConfigCommits=64). STATUS: #84 MERGED (2026-08-11, two review rounds, APPROVE). Two review notes for later PRs: the collapsed-changes count in a status log entry lives only in the prose summary (a structured member would fit the envelope discipline - PR-E or follow-on); ClaimableAfter's doc comment slightly overstates its contract when --into a done-tagged status unblocks a dependent outside the counted population (one-line doc fix).

**Remaining:**
- PR-D (rendering + web read-only): presentation.NewBoard(tasks, vocabulary); TaskView.ResolvedStatus/StatusUnresolved; unknown region narrows to unresolvable-through-the-chain (copy update); terminal wideBoardMinimumFor(n) per-column budget (140 at six preserved); FIX the Move/Place stored-status anchor-bucket disagreement — core's TestMoveAndPlaceDisagreeAboutAStaleAnchor is pinned to fail loudly when fixed, flip it to assert agreement; revisit nextRank/movedRank stored-status bucketing (PR-A seam); webui: Options gains a vocabulary RESOLVER (func — serve runs for hours), GET /api/vocabulary, TasksDocument.vocabularyHead, DELETE the hardcoded statusDefinitions JS array (derive from rendered [data-status] columns; data-default-status attribute replaces hardcoded "backlog" at index.html ~:771/:782), [data-vocabulary-notice] with Reload on vocabularyHead change (NEVER rebuild columns live — card node identity is the protected invariant), knownStatus per-request, create/edit select from columns, drag/drop to custom columns validated at the boundary. Node-harness tests: parity across both boards with a custom vocabulary, select options, /tasks/new default, unresolved card in the region, notice-without-node-replacement.
- PR-E (docs): guidelines status table -> vocabulary-driven with # and Tags columns + tags legend (machine meaning of default/next/done); lifecycle prose tag-derived (renders identically for defaults); heading "Canonical statuses" -> "Statuses"; regeneration on every vocabulary mutation via Reconcile semantics (stale rewritten, modified refused) + --no-docs flag on mutating verbs; README status-vocabulary section; skills/workbook/SKILL.md wording. NO vocabulary block in .workbook/config.json (decided; ProjectConfig comparability is load-bearing). Story moves to IN-REVIEW at PR-E.

**Watch items:** ledger-present cli-list p95 ~140ms on the review host — ~10ms margin to the agreed 150ms projection_meta-cache trigger (cache design pre-agreed, keyed by ledger head; implement only if the margin closes); status log --all walk deliberately unbounded; non-ASCII label byte-padding documented-not-fixed in RenderStatusList.

**After this story:** story 3 (WB-01KZ1J4GVHWNCH66H49XT24WMS — DefaultVocabulary drops blocked for MINTED projects only, legacy fallback keeps six, migration note in status list, ~23 StatusBlocked test refs sweep, then dogfood `workbook status delete blocked --into backlog` on this repo) and story 4 (WB-01KZHJ5YGYJ46ZAEBJT5EZ2BAJ — see its re-scoped description). Web admin panel story WB-01KZRJ1BA5DV3WW6HJ2F9JGS6G depends on this story.
